text:
Aisha: Quick proposal — can we tweak the weekly triage to alternate between a 30m live sync and an async pre-read week? Idea is: live weeks focus only on blockers + owner assignment; async weeks handle backlog and low-pri polish. Thoughts? @Tom @Priya

Tom: +1 for shorter live. Mornings work better for me for quick owner handoffs.

Priya: Agree. Also: can we formalize owner pairs (primary + buddy) so handoffs are smoother? I can volunteer with Jake for the next rotation.

Jake: I can take next Wed AM as primary. :thumbsup:

Marcos: Suggest we add a dedicated 5m "regressions" slot in the live agenda (they tend to eat time). Also linking the triage board: https://redwood.example/triage-board

oncall-bot: Reminder — current oncall rotation ends 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC.

Aisha: Proposed agenda (keeps live to 30m):
```
30m live (max):
  - 5m rollups / metrics
  - 10m hot/high-priority bugs
  - 5m regressions
  - 8m assign owners & actions / quick unblock
  - 2m AOB / followups
Async week: backlog notes + attachments in #triage-prereads by Tue 5pm
Owner pairing: primary + buddy for 48h ack window
```

Tom: LGTM. Can we shorten the owner ack window to 48h instead of 72h? Faster turnarounds on tiny fixes would help.

Priya: 48h is fine for non-blockers, as long as owners ack within ~2h during their workday.

Jake: +1 for 48h. Also would be helpful to have a tiny pre-read template so folks don't write a wall of text.

Aisha: Pre-read template (inline):
- one-line summary
- impact (prod/regression/local)
- repro or logs (attach)
- proposed next step + suggested owner

Aisha: Action items: Priya + Jake will cover next Wed (2143653600) as primary/buddy. I'll update the calendar entry and create #triage-prereads. Anyone else want to swap into the rotation?

Marcos: I can be backup for this March cycle. :handshake:

Tom: I'll ping infra to post any incident summaries to #triage-prereads before the meeting.

Priya: I'll create the first pre-read thread tonight with two backlog items.

Jake: Thanks all — feels cleaner. :rocket:

Aisha: Final check: everyone ok with 30m live + alternate async week? Reply with :thumbsup: if yes.

Tom: :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup:

Marcos: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Calendar updated: "Weekly Triage (30m live / alternate async)" — Wednesdays 09:00 UTC.
